denominators: Whole table undefined if any relevant query descriptor is unavailable or I1/I2 disagree. Per-query comparison uses only matched defined unique query identities; report registered probe records, unique identities, defined/undefined and unmatched counts. A duplicate identity makes all records in that projection undefined. Source-clustered intervals, same source/model nesting as primary drift.
descriptor: Consensus I1/I2 decision/reason/provider/action label plus the unique verified native s->u->c->b->a identifiers, provider/targets, all full five native path nodes, and directly referenced action locator/input-schema/output-schema/runtime-parameter nodes.
finalization_only: After review, copy exact source bytes; freeze this supplement with final extension plan SHA and final artifact paths. Do not modify approved primary plan/code to replace its metrics.
limits: Supplement is a comparison of the selected declared path and action definition, not arbitrary semantic equivalence, full capability/effect closure equivalence, or runtime adoption. It does not rename providers or hide real action/path/endpoint/target/schema-field changes.
metrics: case-namespace-only descriptor table change (raw differs, adjusted equal)

normalization.exact_leading_pattern: KnownKind + hyphen + exact assembler case token + hyphen; preserve suffix exactly. No unanchored replacement.
normalization.identifier_slots: Only enumerated node id/reference fields, path identifier fields, consensus label.action, and the four known SchemaReference JSON modelBinding fields.
normalization.normal_form: A structured identifier token {assembler_identifier_kind,case_prefix_removed:true,suffix}; prevents collision with arbitrary literal IDs.
normalization.schema_text: Parse JSON to adjust only enumerated modelBinding reference fields; canonical key ordering has no semantic effect. Do not rewrite other strings or schema constraints.
normalization.unchanged: Provider wire/entity IDs, target IDs, user/agent IDs, semantic text, endpoint/tool/topic values, all other schema fields, unknown ID prefixes, node/edge order, and all suffix differences.

preserved_primary: Approved provider-change, raw declared-ID query/table, byte, fingerprint and fault-transition metrics are unchanged and remain primary or originally designated secondary. Report their mechanical case-namespace sensitivity explicitly.

unavailable_data_policy: Descriptor/index extraction errors become typed unavailable reasons without stopping other runs. Known probe counts retain explicit defined/undefined denominators; unavailable counts are null, never inferred as zero. Prescan all source-object/start-agent query identities and reject duplicates for the whole projection before any assignment.
